When in doubt, take it easy.

firstrun.assetsBody: Zero to Apex generates car photos and track maps from YOUR Automobilista 2 installation. Nothing from the game is redistributed. This takes about 3–6 minutes, temporarily uses up to ~10 GB of disk space while extracting (freed automatically when it finishes) and keeps ~450 MB when done. You can skip it — the app works with placeholders and you can generate them later from Settings.

firstrun.assetsToolCorrupt: The extraction tool that ships with the app (PCarsTools.exe) is damaged, so it cannot start. This usually means an interrupted install or an antivirus that quarantined part of it. Reinstall the app — and if your antivirus flags it, allow the install folder — then try again.

prefs.autoSwitchDesc: Bring Automobilista 2 to the front when a race starts, and return the app to the front when it ends. Turn off to manage the window yourself with the controls at the top right.
prefs.launchModeDesc: How the Play button launches Automobilista 2: flat screen or virtual reality. Only applies when the app launches the game; if AMS2 is already running, Play just links to it. prefs.launchNoticeDesc: Show the hands-off reminder for a few seconds after you press Rent or Race, while we walk the game's menus and write your race into Custom Race. A click of yours lands in that same menu and undoes it. Turn it back on here if you dismissed it with "don't show this again".
prefs.simRaceDesc: With this on, the race is not launched in the game: the mod fabricates the result in a few seconds (almost always a podium, it can fail) so you can test career progress. Same switch as the one on the connection screen; applies to the next race you launch.
prefs.sub: Window & focus behavior of the manager app
prefs.title: App preferences
prefs.uiScaleDesc: Makes the content bigger inside the same window: text and controls grow, and a little less fits on screen. Handy when the app sits on a far or angled monitor. It applies right away and is remembered. Shortcuts: Ctrl + and Ctrl -, and Ctrl 0 to go back to 100%.
prefs.vrAms2GazeOffHint: Off: AMS2 won't click the menu option you stare at. Use your wheel, controller or keyboard in the game menus. Applied when the game launches.
prefs.vrAms2GazeOnHint: On: staring at an option in the AMS2 menus clicks it. With the app panel in front of you, the game may click whatever is behind it by accident. Applied when the game launches.
prefs.vrConfirmButtonFallback: If that device is not connected when the game starts, {{key}} clicks instead.
prefs.vrConfirmKeyClash: {{key}} also confirms in AMS2. Pressing it will probably do something besides the click.
prefs.vrConfirmKeyDesc: This key acts as the click on the panel, whether you are aiming with your gaze or with a controller. Takes effect the next time you launch the game.
prefs.vrConfirmKeyWarn: Don't pick a key that also confirms in AMS2: both actions would fire at once.
prefs.vrConfirmPadUnreadable: The game cannot read the buttons of {{name}}. Press a button on your wheel, button box or an Xbox-compatible controller, or a key.
prefs.vrConfirmPressAny: Press a key or a wheel/controller button…
prefs.vrOverlayDesc: Show a floating panel with the app inside the headset when you play in VR, with a pointer to click on it. Works the same on SteamVR and on Oculus. It deploys in the menus and retracts while you drive. Takes effect the next time you launch the game.

rival_duel_beef:
Here we are again, {player}. You, me, and another messy race at {track}. It's always you, isn't it.

I'm past being surprised by it now. This is just what we are.

One of these seasons one of us ends the other's day for good. Won't be me.

rival_duel_beef_v1:
Of course it was you at {track}, {player}. It's always you.

This is the second, third time we've turned a Sunday into a mess between us, and I've stopped pretending that's a coincidence.

You and me, we don't do clean. Fine. I stopped needing it clean a while ago.
rival_duel_beef_v2:
You again, {player}. Every time I look at a timing screen your name is next to mine.

Fine. I am done sharing that piece of track.
rival_duel_beef_v3:
You and me for the same metre of asphalt, race after race, {player}.

This does not end in a handshake.
rival_duel_calm:
Good scrap out there, {player}. {track} was clean and it was fast. That's how it's supposed to feel.

You held every inch out there and made me work for all of it. Respect.

We'll do it again, and I'll be a tenth quicker next time. Count on it.

rival_duel_calm_v1:

I'm coming for that position back.
rival_duel_heated:
Enjoy that one while it lasts, {player}. You got by me at {track}, fine, but you know as well as I do it was on the edge.

Next time I'm not leaving you the room. You'll have to actually be faster, not just braver.

See you out there.

rival_duel_heated_v1:
Don't get comfortable, {player}. {track} went your way, I'll give you that much. Once.

I've watched the replay and I know exactly where I lost it, and it won't happen again.

You had your day. The next one's mine. Bring everything you've got.
rival_duel_heated_v2:
All race in my mirrors at {track}, and that is where you stayed.

Chase me as long as you like. That gap is my property.
rival_duel_heated_v3:
I saw you coming at {track}. Saw you, measured you, shut the door.

Nothing personal. The front is taken.

Enjoy the quiet. It doesn't last.

tour.calendar.advance.b: Time runs day by day until something worth stopping for. Set what stops it and see what you would cross before you commit.
tour.calendar.filters.b: Narrow the list by availability, era or discipline.
tour.calendar.intro.b: The master calendar. Pick a round, pay the entry fee and go racing. Time only moves forward.
tour.calendar.list.b: Races grouped by day. Green means you can enter; a lock tells you what you are missing.
tour.championships.detail.b: Points, rivals and your position in the selected championship.
tour.championships.intro.b: The seasons you are enrolled in and the ones you could join.
tour.garage.grid.b: Everything you have bought, with its class and value.
tour.garage.intro.b: The cars you own. Team seats lend you their car; owning one lets you enter races on your own.
tour.hub.card.b: Who you are: identity, fame and trophies.
tour.hub.events.b: Limited time races with their own rewards. Enter them from here.
tour.hub.glance.b: The key numbers of your season.
tour.hub.intro.b: Your career at a glance. Check it after each race to see where you stand.

tour.market.rep.b: What teams see when they look at you.

tour.memories.rail.b: Eras you own are ready to race. The rest show the car you need to buy to get in, and its price.
tour.paddock.intro.b: Who drives where, and until when. Seats only come into play during the transfer window; the decision week settles them all at once.
tour.prerace.actions.b: This fires the race in AMS2 and the app steps aside. Drive, finish, and the result comes back here.
tour.prerace.cars.b: Cars you can race today: your own or your team's.
